'''Dunya Ertan''' (DeckTech handle '''Hardpack''')<ref name="dt-23127">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23127 power of Rebel strike team], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 4 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23127/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23127/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009192919/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23127/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]] list on DeckTech (''power of Rebel strike team''). Dunya posted a [[Light]] [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]] list on DeckTech (''we dont need a sticking hypergenerator'')<ref name="dt-23051">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23051 we dont need a sticking hypergenerator], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 29 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23051/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23051/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009202036/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23051/ Wayback Machine].</ref>.
